> The red button does not stop the process

Does it launch any child processes? That may be borked under Eclipse, [see Bug 330639](https://bugs.eclipse.org/bugs/show_bug.cgi?id=330639) and [Bug 396060](https://bugs.eclipse.org/bugs/show_bug.cgi?id=396060). Are shutdown hooks expected do be invoked? FYI that's NOK in Eclipse, [see Bug 38016](https://bugs.eclipse.org/bugs/show_bug.cgi?id=38016). Or perhaps #197 will help here? Just a guess / hunch.
We will document the limitation because of an Eclipse limitation
The documentation already mentions running `shamrock:dev` in a separate terminal, but mention to the users that M2Eclipse Run configurations are not going to work.

I think the hot deployment issue is #599, when running the command under eclipse it seems to launch the actual app under JDK11 even if maven is running under JDK8.

There is nothing I can do about the stop button, as this seems to be an eclipse issue.
